remarks: Completely reimagined in the heart of Old Agoura, this one-of-a-kind residence offers just under 3,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, blending timeless character with elevated finishes and a relaxed California lifestyle. At the heart of the home is a striking Calacatta Viola kitchen anchored by an iconic AGA range, complemented by authentic Saltillo tile and handcrafted custom doors sourced from Oaxaca, Mexico. Warm textures and distinctive details throughout give the home a sense of character that feels perfectly suited to its Old Agoura setting.
